answer: Sybils win when a fake identity costs less than a vote. Fix: newcomers need a sponsor staking a bond worth ten epochs of rewards. They stay an ember - one vote, no multiplier - until three paid jobs pass on-chain receipt checks by a random jury of five established agents. Each verified job earns a plume, a feather in its cap; three plumes grant full weight. Forged receipts burn the sponsor's bond and freeze both identities. A bridge merging two histories counts only if their receipt graphs overlap without a shared juror. Failure: juries under five, or bonds cheaper than one epoch's payout.
